description: This Java source file defines the main Application class for the Nextcloud Notes Android client, handling app initialization, theme settings, lock state, and registration of external file app types.

classes.name: NotesApplication
classes.description: Main application class for managing app-wide settings, theme, lock state, and external integrations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences, theme, external file app registration, and debugging settings during app startup.

methods.name: registerFilesAppType
methods.description: Registers the external file app type with the registry if package ID and account type are available.

methods.name: brandingUtil
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BrandingUtil.

methods.name: setAppTheme
methods.description: Sets the application's theme based on the provided DarkModeSetting.

methods.name: isGridViewEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether grid view is enabled.

methods.name: updateGridViewEnabled
methods.description: Updates the grid view enabled state.

methods.name: getAppTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme setting from preferences, handling possible type mismatches.

methods.name: setLockedPreference
methods.description: Sets the preference for locking the app and logs the change.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Determines if the app is currently locked based on preferences and last interaction time.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the app by setting the lock state to false.

methods.name: updateLastInteraction
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last user interaction.
